Ammunition Stance

Requirement: A weapon with the Ammunition trait.

Stashing extra ammo in your palm, in your weapon, or otherwise close at hand, you prepare to unleash a storm of shots at the enemy.

Pros

Overload

  • Anytime you make an attack that expends ammunition, you can expend an extra piece of ammunition (which breaks on impact), to make your attack deal an additional 1d4 weapon damage if it hits.

Ammo Scavenger

  • You can pick up ammunition at your feet, spent or otherwise, as a free action.
  • When picked up, these can be fired with a +2 bonus to hit with these this turn.
  • Broken ammo otherwise cannot be fired.

Focus Fire

  • As a reaction when you injure a creature with ammunition, the target also gains 1 @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.R54LQEKSDXNQ3N75]{Bleeding} and becomes your “mark” until the start of your next turn.
    Once per creature turn, if your “mark” takes damage, you can immediately do one of the following as a non-action:
    1. Reload your weapon.
    2. Fire a single 1 base weapon damage attack at them.

Cons

Spray and Pray

  • All attacks cost one extra ammunition.
